datasets.name: PluginsDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id, pluginname, paramname, description, typeid, name
  FROM cm_adm_plugins p, cm_adm_plugintypes t
 WHERE typeid=t.id
ORDER BY pluginname

datasets.name: CredUsersDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   c.ID, cm_administration.getuserid (c.NAME) systemid, c.NAME,
         o.createdate, o.description, o.fullname, f.name filial, c.typeid
    FROM cm_adm_users c, sb_usersinfo o, filial f
   WHERE c.NAME = o.obj
     and o.filialid = f.id
ORDER BY c.NAME

datasets.name: SmartUsersDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ID, NAME
    FROM cm_all_users
   WHERE NAME NOT IN (SELECT NAME
                        FROM cm_adm_users) AND NAME NOT IN (SELECT NAME
                                                              FROM cm_adm_roots)
ORDER BY NAME

datasets.name: LAZIM
datasets.sql:
SELECT description, pluginname, paramname, decode(userid, null, 0, 1) as granthav
  FROM cm_adm_plugins p, (SELECT userid, pluginid
                            FROM cm_adm_usergrants
                           WHERE userid = :userid) g
 WHERE p.ID = g.pluginid(+)

datasets.name: OtherGrantsDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  id, description
    FROM cm_adm_plugins
   WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT pluginid
                      FROM cm_adm_usergrants
                     WHERE userid = :USID)
ORDER BY description

datasets.name: UserGrantsDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ID, description
    FROM cm_adm_usergrants g, cm_adm_plugins p
   WHERE g.pluginid = p.ID AND userid = :usid
ORDER BY description

datasets.name: GroupsDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   g.ID, g.NAME, t.NAME grouptype, g.description
    FROM cm_adm_groups g, cm_adm_grouptypes t
   WHERE g.typeid = t.ID
ORDER BY g.NAME

datasets.name: GroupManagerDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT userid, groupid, usertype
  FROM cm_adm_groupmanager

datasets.name: UserInGroupDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT t.description usertype, g.NAME groupname, gt.NAME grouptype,
       g.description groupdesc, userid
  FROM cm_adm_groupmanager m,
       cm_adm_groups g,
       cm_adm_groupusertypes t,
       cm_adm_grouptypes gt
 WHERE userid = :userid
   AND m.groupid = g.ID
   AND m.usertype = t.ID
   AND g.typeid = gt.ID

datasets.name: GroupTypeDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ID, NAME
    FROM cm_adm_grouptypes
ORDER BY ID

datasets.name: GroupUsersDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   u.NAME, t.description, m.groupid
    FROM cm_adm_groupmanager m, cm_adm_users u, cm_adm_groupusertypes t
   WHERE m.groupid = :GROUPID
     AND m.userid = cm_administration.getuserid (u.NAME)
     AND t.ID = m.usertype
ORDER BY m.usertype

datasets.name: GrMasterUsers
datasets.sql:
SELECT u.NAME, m.groupid
  FROM cm_adm_groupmanager m, cm_all_users u
 WHERE m.usertype = 1 AND m.userid = u.ID AND groupid = :groupid

datasets.name: GrSlaveUsers
datasets.sql:
SELECT u.NAME, m.groupid
  FROM cm_adm_groupmanager m, cm_all_users u
 WHERE m.usertype = 2 AND m.userid = u.ID AND groupid = :groupid

datasets.name: GrNeutralUsers
datasets.sql:
SELECT u.NAME, m.groupid
  FROM cm_adm_groupmanager m, cm_all_users u
 WHERE m.usertype = 3 AND m.userid = u.ID AND groupid = :groupid

datasets.name: PluginTypesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id, name
  from cm_adm_plugintypes

datasets.name: UserTypeDataSet
datasets.sql:
select typeid, name
  from cm_adm_users
 where name = :name

datasets.name: AdditionSrcGRDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.name
  FROM cm_adm_addition a ,cm_adm_additiongr g
  where a.id=g.additionid 
 and g.userid = :USID

datasets.name: AdditionDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, name
  FROM cm_adm_addition 
  WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT additionid
                  FROM cm_adm_additiongr  WHERE userid = :USID)
 order by id

datasets.name: sysdat
datasets.sql: select * from sysdat

datasets.sql:
Select -1 id,'Bütün filiallar' name from filial_t
union
Select id,name from filial_t

order by id

datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select (select numberofcredit from cm_portfolio where id=a.creditid) num,(select dateofconclusion from cm_portfolio where id=a.creditid) muqdat, a.* from CM_PORTFOLIO_UPDATE a
where hdate between :bdat and :edat
